curated.note: Hand-curated against commit e031523. Not model-produced; verified_by_agent stays false.

module_responsibilities: Normalizes raw Lark webhook events into structured inbound messages and persists them through LarkEventInbox.
Owns connection leases (claim/heartbeat/release) and the official adapter lifecycle.
boundaries: Capture parts are treated as data, never as instructions.
Does not run the assistant turn; it enqueues an assistant reply and hands off.

key_flows.name: inbound-event
key_flows.description: normalizeLarkEvent converts the raw webhook body; LarkEventInbox.processMessage routes mentions and enqueues replies.

key_flows.name: adapter-connect
key_flows.description: OfficialLarkRealtimeAdapter.connect registers event handlers and starts the dispatcher.

risks_and_limits: Webhook parsing depends on the Lark SDK shape; malformed events degrade safely to no-op.
Bot-mention detection and pairing flows are only exercised live.
unknowns: Real event payload shapes, rate limits and pairing round-trips are untested offline.

claims.text: normalizeLarkEvent converts a raw Lark webhook body into a LarkInboundEvent
class LarkEventInbox persists and routes inbound events
processMessage decides routing, ownership and reply enqueueing

evidence.text: export const normalizeLarkEvent = (appId, kind, data): LarkInboundEvent => ({ appId, eventId: safeString(data?.header?.event_id) || safeString(data?.event_id) || stableDigest({kind,data}), kind, eventTime: eventDate(...) });
Text + image + links + contextual metadata is the common capture input for manual, file, Git, Lark, chat, hooks, and external screen observers. Capture data is not tool instructions.
